# Handover 1.1

**What landed**
- `7e332f1` — baseline validation/hardening only; no game features or production
  behavior changes.
- Added six high-count word probes at 1/99/9999 with recorded final positions,
  pending count/find/go blur regressions, and blocked modified Escape/Enter/
  Backspace plus Other browser regressions.
- Added the retained baseline probe `tools/experiments/first-playable-timing.ts`
  and `just timing`; it drives the production bundle through sequential synthetic
  keydowns (no Playwright round trips), 3 warmups and 5 measured runs.
- `artifacts/` is ignored. This run's machine-readable result is
  `artifacts/first-playable-timing-baseline.json`; raw logs remain outside Git.

**Baseline receipt**
- Active original IDs/cases: all 50 navigation obligations; first-playable
  requirement IDs/cases remain pending (none owned by 1.1).
- Checks green: `direnv exec . just verify`, `direnv exec . just test` and
  `nix develop --command just verify`: 53 fixture examples, 50 named navigation
  checks, 92 core tests, 24 browser tests (12 development + 12 production),
  typecheck and benchpress lint. `just contract-complete` separately green.
- Repairs: none required. The existing fixed-point word optimization remains.
- Timing, 49 commands on the 40x20 seed, Linux x86_64, Bun 1.3.13, Chromium
  150.0.7871.181: max single dispatch 2.00 ms (`e`, count 9999); most medians
  0.20–0.50 ms. Word high-count finals from start 0: `w`/`W` 6, 799, 799;
  `b`/`B` 0, 0, 0; `e`/`E` 4, 799, 799. No timing threshold is claimed.
- Harness/model/provider: OpenCode / `deepseek/deepseek-flash`, high effort.
  Token/cost/elapsed figures are not available to this session and are not
  invented here.

**Landmark drift**
- None in the named source/tests/justfile. The plan targets `15f3e2c`; the
  working tree already contained the later planning commit `092d919`, but no
  production navigation code differs from the plan's assumptions.
- The old timing script was never in Git; the retained probe is new, not a
  recovered file.

**Deviations from the work order**
- `just timing`, `artifacts/` in `.gitignore` and one README line were added so
  the timing probe is usable and its output cannot be committed accidentally.
- The probe currently measures the existing seed in the production browser. It
  does not yet measure the 240x160 site world or all-space text because this
  stage has no selection/factory path into the browser; final assembly owns
  those extensions.

**What the next session must know**
- Navigation production code is untouched: `words.wordMove`, `model.field/pack/
  view`, `actualApi` and browser blur/input handlers are as landed before this
  unit. `just verify` now includes `first-playable-fixtures`, `contract` and
  `contract-complete`.
- Browser blur coverage is now count, FindRight, FindLeft and Go. Blocked
  Escape/Backspace/Enter and Other preserve a pending find.
- `just timing` builds first, writes to `artifacts/` by default, and accepts an
  optional output path argument. It records environment plus per-command
  samples, final position/mode, median and max.
- No `spec/first-playable/coverage.json` exists yet. Unit 2.1 creates it and
  activates W1/W2 while marking later work pending; baseline work must not be
  presented as a first-playable requirement.
- Benchpress lint still warns about the historical missing
  `vim-game-bend-main.md` link in `docs/workbench/first-playable-rts.md`; the
  command exits green. No flake file changed, so `check-nix` was not rerun.

**Open problems**
- Extend the timing probe to all-space text via the real core factory and to
  the 240x160 world with sites in the browser-facing units; add the bounded
  direct-core stress probe required by shared §9 then.
- Measurements are one host, one headless Chromium and one production bundle;
  they are finite evidence, not a universal latency or usability claim.
